answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available, and they match system-prompted ranges best: top-1 agreement 0.875 (0.861-0.908), sequence agreement 0.359 (0.31-0.48), TV 0.135 (0.108-0.144), Token-DiFR gap 0.487 (0.28-0.52), and raw-score shift/TV 3.3 (3.3-3.9). KL of 0.348 is just above the system-prompted range but far above fine-tuned (max 0.205), as is the DiFR gap (fine-tuned max 0.31). Quantized is ruled out because its KL is at most 0.071 and its top-1 agreement is at least 0.945. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, but it fits poorly, since its top-1 agreement tops out at 0.938 and its TV at 0.099. Base is ruled out since all values are non-zero.
